user.title: Realtime voice bridge
user.description: Pick the ESPHome voice device (host and encryption key are taken from its ESPHome entry) and enter an OpenAI API key.

data.api_key: OpenAI API key (leave empty to read rtbridge.env in the HA config dir)

error.no_key: No OpenAI key: enter it or put OPENAI_API_KEY=… into rtbridge.env in the HA config dir

data.ha_tool: Let the agent control Home Assistant (home_assistant tool)
data.vad_eagerness: Turn detection: server (0.9 s silence) or semantic eagerness
data.echo_guard: Mute mic for N s when the device starts speaking (echo guard)
data.turn_stall: Force the turn if no answer N s after speech stops
data.playback_duck: Mic multiplier while the device is speaking (echo vs barge-in)
